dataset: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection public training data
representation: Frozen cached DINOv2-336 embeddings, masked mean over valid views
partition: Deterministic SHA-256 of report group for client assignment and independent report-group holdout
actualDeployment: All five client optimizations emulated within one Modal process
limitations: Public-dataset partitions are not independent hospitals.
The same holdout is monitored each round; peak AUC is descriptive, not an independent final-test estimate.
Frozen-backbone training provenance has not been audited against this experiment's holdout.
This MLP is separate from the six-slot DINOv2 checkpoint ensemble used for uploaded-study inference.
No certified anonymization, secure aggregation, or differential privacy guarantee.
